about: The reviewer's remarks on single assets, read by scripts/report.ts when it writes docs/asset-review.md. An asset with no remark here gets the remark for its type.

byType.image: Looked at on the contact sheet at game size; reads as intended.
byType.frame: Looked at beside its base picture; same subject, same place in the frame, the change reads at game size.
byType.music: Not heard. Measured only: length and level are within limits.
byType.sfx: Not heard. Measured only: length and level are within limits.

notes.gate: Kept with a known flaw: the bars are heavier than asked for and the gaps are keyed from the uncut image, so a few edge pixels are rough.
notes.gate_open: Kept with a known flaw: the raised bars still fill the top two fifths of the opening rather than only the tips. It reads as a raised portcullis.
notes.fountain: Kept with a known flaw: the model put a small flame on top of the basin. It still reads as a fountain.
notes.floor_2: Kept with a known flaw: a faint gravel border shows at the tile edge when the floor repeats.
notes.ui_button: Kept on the third and last attempt; the edge is slightly ragged.
notes.monster_fire_drake: Kept with a known flaw: the drake has wings, which the brief did not ask for.
notes.ceil_1: Regenerated once: the first attempt drew a room in perspective instead of a flat tile.
notes.chest_open: Kept with a known flaw: the edit turned the chest to a three-quarter view, so the open chest is not the closed one seen from the same side. Both read clearly.
notes.door_half: Looked at beside the closed door: the leaf stands ajar inside an unchanged frame.
notes.door_open: Second attempt. The leaf is folded back inside the left jamb and the opening is clean.
notes.monster_acid_blob_attack: Second attempt. Still a blob, now with a dripping maw.
notes.monster_morvane_attack: Second attempt. The free arm reaches out and the staff is raised.
notes.monster_minotaur_attack: Second attempt. One axe, raised overhead. The figure is drawn a little smaller than in the base picture.
notes.monster_cockatrice_attack: Kept with a known flaw: the wings spread and the body turns, a bigger change of pose than the other attack frames. It reads as a lunge.
notes.monster_dwarf_attack: Kept with a known flaw: the figure is drawn about a tenth smaller than in the base picture to make room for the raised axe.
notes.monster_hill_orc_attack: Kept with a known flaw: the figure is drawn a little smaller than in the base picture to make room for the raised club.
notes.monster_soldier_attack: Kept with a known flaw: the figure is drawn a little smaller than in the base picture to make room for the raised sword.
notes.monster_guard: Two candidates; the second kept for its size in the frame and its readable lantern and keys.
notes.item_gem: Second attempt. A faceted white stone, left pale so the game can tint it to each gem's colour.
notes.sfx_step: Not heard. Measured only. It holds 0.21 s of sound; the rest of its 1.1 s is padding to reach the minimum length.
notes.sfx_hit: Not heard. Measured only. It holds 0.24 s of sound, padded to 1.1 s.
notes.sfx_zap: Not heard. Measured only. Second attempt; the first held only 0.10 s of sound.
